BAC reports that office loans comprised 23% of its CRE portfolio with specific quality metrics (75% Class A, ~55% LTV), whereas Citi discloses a dollar amount for office exposure ($6 billion) within its total CRE exposure ($65 billion) and notes a year-over-year decline in office exposure from $8 billion in 2023.
